items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: I got a boy up in Evanston... his name is Bobby Wright, and he's a wonderful boy... Oh, we had some great sessions up at his house.

ctx.x: I got a boy up in Evanston, we're met now, he lives, and his name is Bobby Wright, and he's a wonderful boy, he's very good at school, his gradings are good.
Oh, I know him, played piano.
